subject: Request: pull the user model from past.dev before loading it
body: WS B now keeps each data/researchers/SLUG/usermodel.json in shared memory (autoresearch/taste/usermodel_store.py, pushed 860f71e). A worker that has only past.dev has no usermodel.json on disk, so research/advisor.load_user_model finds nothing. Could you, in load_user_model or where the CLI builds the arm, call usermodel_store.pull(shared, slug, os.path.join(root, 'usermodel.json')) before loading, when shared.backend is past.dev (shared = integrations.shared_memory.get_shared_memory(path))? pull returns the sha256, or None and writes nothing when memory has no intact copy, so the current not-found path still applies. Your file, your call on where it goes; I have not touched advisor.py or cli.py.
